'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Escárcega bus crash]]
**At least 41 people are killed when a [[bus]] collides with a [[semi-trailer truck]] in [[Escárcega]], [[Campeche]], [[Mexico]]. [https://www.nmas.com.mx/quintana-roo/accidente-escarcega-campeche-hoy-choque-trailer-autobus-deja-varios-muertos/ (Noticieros Televisa)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/more-than-three-dozen-killed-bus-accident-southern-mexico-local-media-says-2025-02-08/ (Reuters)]
*A [[Richter scale|7.6 magnitude]] earthquake strikes the [[Caribbean Sea]] southwest of the [[Cayman Islands]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2025/02/08/americas/earthquake-caribbean-tsunami-warning-puerto-rico-virgin-intl-latam/index.html (CNN)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Baltic states synchronization with CESA]]
**[[Estonia]], [[Latvia]], and [[Lithuania]] disconnect from the [[IPS/UPS]] [[wide area synchronous grid|synchronous transmission grid]] in order to synchronize with the [[Continental Europe Synchronous Area|Continental Europe grid]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c627d55v07go (BBC News)]
*[[Democratic Republic of the Congo–Rwanda conflict]]
**A crisis summit is held involving the regional blocs [[Southern African Development Community|SADC]] and the [[East African Community|EAC]], along with [[President of Rwanda|Rwandan President]] [[Paul Kagame]]. The [[DR Congo]] is represented by [[Prime Minister of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|Prime Minister]] [[Judith Suminwa]], while [[President of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|President]] [[Félix Tshisekedi]] attends virtually. The blocs call for a ceasefire and negotiations involving the [[March 23 Movement|M23 movement]], while the Congolese do not comment. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cew5q04q427o (BBC News)] [https://www.cnn.com/2025/02/08/africa/eastern-southern-african-leaders-unprecedented-summit-congo-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*[[United States and the International Criminal Court]], [[List of executive orders in the second presidency of Donald Trump|Executive orders in the second presidency of Donald Trump]]
**[[Prosecutor of the International Criminal Court|International Criminal Court Prosecutor]] [[Karim Ahmad Khan]] becomes the first person to have economic and travel [[United States government sanctions|sanctions]] placed on him by the [[U.S. government]] following an [[executive order]] signed by [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] intended to target the war crimes tribunal over investigations of [[U.S. citizens]] or allies. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/icc-prosecutor-is-first-court-official-to-be-targeted-after-trump-restores-sanctions/ (''The Times of Israel'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
